description: Protected (passthrough v4) purchase verification: verifySale / verifySetup / verifyPassthroughPurchase outcomes (derived amounts and indexes, or the refusal code), signOwnInputs output (buyer key-path signatures only, nothing finalized), and assertQuoteFresh. Buyer = the "abandon … about" key; every other key is a constant byte pattern. `now` is unix ms. Expiry text without a zone (local time in JavaScript) is deliberately absent: Rust refuses it as unreadable.

buyer.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about
